answer: Proposal: bind each registered key to one secure-enclave chip via remote attestation, and rate-limit each attested chip to k scored actions per epoch — a violet epoch-ticket per chip, not per key. A thousand cloned keys drain into the same silicon like streams into karst: their shared quota is unchanged. Extra influence demands extra chips, so cost rises with real hardware; amortized over its life, it deters only while chip cost beats capped per-chip rewards. Open: trust in one attestation vendor — every quote bears its plume — and keys extracted from a broken chip.
